title: Sort Colors
statement: The array holds only 0, 1 and 2, representing red, white and blue. Sort it in place in a single pass without using a library sort.
hints: Counting how many of each value and rewriting the array is two passes and perfectly valid.
For one pass, keep three regions: settled 0s at the front, settled 2s at the back, and 1s in the middle.
This is the Dutch national flag partition: a low pointer, a high pointer, and a scanner. On a 2 you swap to the back but must NOT advance the scanner, since the swapped-in value is unexamined.
